prompts.A:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: polished landscape brand concept presentation board, direction A, for Utkal Project.
Reference image 1 is the earlier book-and-boat logo concept, a starting idea only. Evolve its open-book pages / sails above a shallow hull into a more distinctive, compact and crisp emblem. Retain the idea, simplify narrow negative spaces and balance the hull. The name is now exactly "Utkal Project", never Utkala.
Create one beautiful coherent board on completely opaque flat warm ivory #F5EBDD. Confident contemporary literary identity; editorial warmth with forward-looking energy. Deep red #8F2435 primary, charcoal #24211F, lagoon teal #245C59 secondary, restrained ochre #C9923E ornament. Flat shapes, no gradients, no aged paper, no shadows or 3D.
Layout: small top label "A / Book & boat". Main area: generous horizontal emblem plus "Utkal Project" in elegant sturdy readable serif lettering, with exact tagline below in clear sentence-case sans serif: "Rediscover Utkal. Reimagine Odisha."
Lower area: three aligned practical application mockups, labelled "Website", "Avatar", "Story card". Website is a simple header strip with smaller same emblem/name, legible tagline and navigation "Explore  Stories  About". Avatar is an ivory version of the emblem alone in a deep-red square, no tiny tagline. Story card is typographic, exact title "Stories worth sharing", the small same logo/name and subtle abstract colour fields, no invented documentary photograph. A narrow bottom row shows the same emblem in red on ivory, ivory on teal, and charcoal on ivory. All representations MUST use the same geometry. Generous margins, clear hierarchy, beautiful typographic balance.
Small footer "Concept for review". No seal, temple silhouette, sun wheel, sacred figure, Odia lettering, trademark symbol or extra brand names. This is a concept board, not a claim of final production readiness.
prompts.B:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: polished landscape brand concept presentation board, direction B, for Utkal Project.
Create a distinctive wordmark-led identity for the exact name "Utkal Project". Typography is the hero: robust, contemporary literary serif with carefully balanced spacing and a memorable subtle custom flourish in the U, readable and warm rather than ornate or corporate. Both words must feel like one brand, Project must not look like an afterthought. A small companion monogram derived from the U and P lettering must be crisp and recognizable. Do not use a boat/book icon; this is a genuinely different wordmark-led route.
Completely opaque flat warm ivory #F5EBDD backdrop. Deep red #8F2435 primary, charcoal #24211F, lagoon teal #245C59 secondary, restrained ochre #C9923E ornament. Flat shapes, no gradients, no aged paper, shadows or 3D.
Layout: small top label "B / Wordmark". Main area: large beautiful "Utkal Project" wordmark, with exact tagline below in clear sentence-case sans serif: "Rediscover Utkal. Reimagine Odisha."
Lower area: three aligned practical application mockups labelled "Website", "Avatar", "Story card". Website is a simple header strip with the same wordmark, legible tagline and navigation "Explore  Stories  About". Avatar is the companion UP monogram alone in ivory in a deep-red square, no tiny tagline. Story card is typographic, exact title "Stories worth sharing", small same wordmark and subtle abstract colour fields, no invented documentary photograph. Narrow bottom row shows the same monogram in red on ivory, ivory on teal, and charcoal on ivory. Consistent letterforms and mark geometry across all examples.
Small footer "Concept for review". Generous margins, clear hierarchy and calm confident composition. No seal, temple, sun wheel, sacred figure, Odia lettering, trademark symbol or extra brand names. No Utkala. This is a concept board, not a claim of final production readiness.
prompts.BRefinement: Edit this Utkal Project concept board. Preserve its overall layout, exact large Utkal Project wordmark, approved tagline "Rediscover Utkal. Reimagine Odisha.", palette and mockups. Replace the UP monogram in the large Avatar square and ALL three small bottom colour variants with a crisp, elegantly composed UTP monogram containing all three letters U, T and P, because UTP is the approved project prefix. Keep it simple and readable; subtle overlapping of letters is fine but each of U, T and P must remain identifiable. Use consistent geometry in all four monogram instances. No UP-only mark anywhere. Keep all other content unchanged. This remains a raster concept board for review.
